newsitem.title: USA: Foster gets go-ahead on China power plant.
newsitem.headline: Foster gets go-ahead on China power plant.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said Tuesday its subsidiary Foster Wheeler Energy Corp got the go-ahead on a $174.4 million boiler equipment contract for a power plant in China.
Foster said it will deliver two anthracite-fired boilers for the plant, which will be built in Yijing in the Chinese province of Hebei. The company won the contract in the fourth quarter of 1996.

The company said the plant's owner is Hebei Hanfeng Power Generating Co, a joint venture between operating power company Hebei Electric Power Corp; Hebei Construction and Investment Corp; North China Power Co; and Siemens AG's subsidiary Siemens Power Development Hanfeng Gmbh.
Siemens said on November 8 it would have a 40 percent stake in the $1.37 billion power plant and would deliver two 660-megawatt generators.
